import chess, chess.polyglot, time, sys
from arena import load_board
V=[0,100,320,335,500,975,0]
N=0; TT={}; start=time.time(); LIMIT=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 60
B=load_board()
def ev(b):
    score=0; phase=sum(len(b.pieces(p,c))*v for p,v in [(2,1),(3,1),(4,2),(5,4)] for c in [0,1])/24
    phase=min(1,phase)
    for c in [0,1]:
        s=0; pawns=b.pieces(1,c); enemy=b.pieces(1,not c); king=b.king(c)
        for p in range(1,7):
            for sq in b.pieces(p,c):
                f=chess.square_file(sq); r=chess.square_rank(sq) if c else 7-chess.square_rank(sq)
                center=abs(f-3.5)+abs(r-3.5)
                s+=V[p]
                if p==1:
                    s+=r*5+(3.5-abs(f-3.5))*3
                    if not any(abs(chess.square_file(t)-f)<=1 and (chess.square_rank(t)>chess.square_rank(sq) if c else chess.square_rank(t)<chess.square_rank(sq)) for t in enemy): s+=[0,0,8,18,35,60,110,0][r]
                    if not any(abs(chess.square_file(t)-f)==1 for t in pawns):s-=14
                    if sum(chess.square_file(t)==f for t in pawns)>1:s-=12
                elif p==2:s+=36-center*10+3*r
                elif p==3:s+=22-center*4+len(b.attacks(sq)&~b.occupied_co[c])*3
                elif p==4:
                    if not any(chess.square_file(t)==f for t in pawns):s+=14 if any(chess.square_file(t)==f for t in enemy) else 25
                    if r==6:s+=20
                    s+=len(b.attacks(sq)&~b.occupied_co[c])
                elif p==5:s+=len(b.attacks(sq)&~b.occupied_co[c])*.6
                elif p==6:
                    s+=(1-phase)*(30-center*10)
                    s+=phase*(-r*13+(15 if f in [1,2,6,7] else -8))
                    for df in [-1,0,1]:
                        ff=f+df
                        if 0<=ff<8:
                            shield=[t for t in pawns if chess.square_file(t)==ff and (chess.square_rank(t)>chess.square_rank(sq) if c else chess.square_rank(t)<chess.square_rank(sq))]
                            s+=phase*(8 if shield else -18)
        if len(b.pieces(3,c))>=2:s+=28
        score+=s if c else -s
    return int(score if b.turn else -score)
def key(b):return chess.polyglot.zobrist_hash(b)
def order(b,m,tt):
    if m==tt:return 100000
    val=0
    if b.is_capture(m):val=10000+10*V[b.piece_type_at(m.to_square) or 1]-V[b.piece_type_at(m.from_square)]
    if m.promotion:val+=8000
    return val

def qs(b,a,z,ply=0):
    global N
    N+=1
    check=b.is_check()
    if ply>9:return ev(b)
    if check:
        ms=list(b.legal_moves)
        if not ms:return -30000+ply
    else:
        v=ev(b)
        if v>=z:return v
        if v>a:a=v
        ms=list(b.generate_legal_captures())
    for m in sorted(ms,key=lambda m:order(b,m,None),reverse=True):
        if not check and not m.promotion and ev(b)+V[b.piece_type_at(m.to_square) or 1]+180<a:continue
        b.push(m); v=-qs(b,-z,-a,ply+1); b.pop()
        if v>=z:return v
        if v>a:a=v
    return a

def search(b,d,a,z,ply=0):
    global N
    N+=1
    if N%1024==0 and time.time()-start>LIMIT:raise TimeoutError
    if b.is_repetition(2) or b.halfmove_clock>=100:return 0
    k=key(b); hit=TT.get(k); tm=None; orig=a
    if hit:
        dep,v,flag,tm=hit
        if dep>=d and ply>0:
            if flag==0:return v
            if flag==1 and v>=z:return v
            if flag==-1 and v<=a:return v
    if d<=0:return qs(b,a,z)
    ms=list(b.legal_moves)
    if not ms:return -30000+ply if b.is_check() else 0
    best=-32000; bm=None
    for m in sorted(ms,key=lambda m:order(b,m,tm),reverse=True):
        b.push(m); v=-search(b,d-1,-z,-a,ply+1);b.pop()
        if v>best:best=v;bm=m
        if v>a:a=v
        if a>=z:break
    TT[k]=(d,best,1 if best>=z else -1 if best<=orig else 0,bm)
    return best

def pv(b):
    b=b.copy(); seq=[]
    for i in range(10):
        hit=TT.get(key(b))
        if not hit or not hit[3] or hit[3] not in b.legal_moves:break
        m=hit[3];seq.append(b.san(m));b.push(m)
    return ' '.join(seq)
print(B.fen(),flush=True)
for d in range(1,10):
    try:
        val=search(B,d,-32000,32000)
        print(d,val,N,round(time.time()-start,1),pv(B),flush=True)
    except TimeoutError:break
